metadata.title: SpeakUp Payatas Mock Test Dataset
metadata.description: Comprehensive mock data for testing incident reporting, staff verification, tracking, analytics, and accuracy evaluation across Barangay Payatas-A and Payatas-B. Contains 88 original + 78 generated reports over 30 days.

reports.description: Barado ang drainage canal sa may kanto. Tuwing umuulan ay mabilis bumaha hanggang tuhod at pumapasok sa kabahayan.

action_history.note: Verified by Barangay Engineering team. Scheduled for drainage declogging.
Maintenance crew deployed on-site with suction equipment.

reports.description: Tubig baha hindi humuhupa dito sa tapat ng chapel, may mga lumulutang na basura at amoy kanal na.
May lumalawit at nag-i-spark na kawad ng kuryente sa poste malapit sa sari-sari store. Delikado lalo na kapag umuulan.

action_history.note: Inspected on-site. MERALCO and BFP Payatas notified immediately.
Barangay Tanod cordoned off the area with caution tape while waiting for utility crew.

reports.description: Tatlong araw nang hindi nakokolekta ang tambak ng basura sa tapat ng basketball court. Dumadami na ang langaw at daga.

action_history.note: Forwarded to QC Waste Management and Barangay Sanitation.
Garbage dump truck dispatched for special clearing.
Basura fully collected and area disinfected with lime powder.

reports.description: Malaking lubak sa gitna ng daan, nadisgrasya na ang isang motor kagabi dahil madilim din ang streetlight.

action_history.note: Verified by traffic patrol. Included in weekly asphalt patching schedule.

reports.description: Lakas ng tugtog at videoke hanggang alas dos ng madaling araw tuwing weekend. Hindi makatulog ang mga may pasok at may sakit.

action_history.note: Tanod patrol dispatched to give verbal warning under QC Anti-Noise Ordinance.
Homeowners complied and turned off sound equipment.

reports.description: Mga kabataang tambay na nag-aaway at nagbabatuhan ng bote tuwing gabi sa madilim na eskinita.
May nagtatapon ng debris at construction waste malapit sa creek. Maaaring magbara kapag nagka-bagyo.

action_history.note: Site inspected. Environmental committee issuing notice of violation to property owner.

reports.description: asdfasdfasdf test report please ignore

action_history.note: Marked as SPAM by administrator. Strike 1 recorded.

sample_feedback.comment: Salamat sa mabilis na pagkilos ng barangay at QC garbage truck! Nalinis agad ang tambak na basura.
Mabilis rumesponde ang mga tanod kagabi. Tahimik na ulit ang kalye.
